nodes.description: address[8] m_owners in MultiOwnable: fixed-size array of multisig owner addresses.
uint m_numOwners in MultiOwnable: number of configured owners (<=8).
uint m_multiRequires in MultiOwnable: number of owner approvals required to execute a protected operation.
mapping(bytes32 => uint) m_pendings: per-operation confirmation bitmask of owners who already approved.
bool paused in Pausable: emergency stop flag governing all whenNotPaused functions.
address tokenPool: contract address holding the entire GPX supply; set to address(this) in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint256) balances: token balances of all accounts including tokenPool.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed: ERC20 allowance table.
uint256 buyRate (default 3731): GPX tokens granted per wei of ETH sent to buy().
uint256 constant TOTAL_SUPPLY = 1e9 * 10**18, minted to tokenPool in the constructor.
MultiOwnable(address[] _multiOwners, uint _multiRequires): validates and stores owners and the required confirmation count.
isOwner(address currentUser) public view: linear scan of m_owners; used by the anyOwner modifier.
checkAndConfirm(address currentUser, bytes32 operation) public: records a per-owner approval bit, counts confirmations and returns true once m_multiRequires is reached. Backs the mostOwner modifier.
pause() mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)) whenNotPaused: sets paused = true and emits Pause.
unpause() mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)) whenPaused: sets paused = false and emits Unpause.
isPause() view public returns(bool): reads the paused flag.
ParcelXGPX(address[] _multiOwners, uint _multiRequires): sets tokenPool = address(this) and assigns TOTAL_SUPPLY to the pool.
totalSupply() public view returns (uint256): returns the constant TOTAL_SUPPLY.
balanceOf(address _owner) public view returns (uint256): returns balances[_owner].
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) onlyPayloadSize(2*32): ERC20 transfer using SafeMath sub/add on balances.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) onlyPayloadSize(3*32): allowance-based transfer, decrements balances and allowed.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) onlyPayloadSize(2*32): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) public view returns (uint256): reads allowed table.
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): adds to the allowance with SafeMath.add.
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): subtracts from the allowance, clamping to zero.
getBuyRate() external view returns (uint256): returns the current buyRate.
setBuyRate(uint256 newBuyRate) mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)): multisig-protected update of buyRate.
buy() payable whenNotPaused: accepts ETH, requires >=0.001 ether, computes tokens = msg.value.mul(buyRate) and moves GPX from tokenPool to msg.sender.
fallback () payable public: forwards any non-zero msg.value to buy().
mallocBudget(address _admin, uint256 _value) mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)): multisig-protected move of GPX out of tokenPool to _admin.
execute(address _to, uint256 _value, string _extra) mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)): multisig-protected ETH payout via _to.transfer(_value).
convertMainchainGPX(string destinationAccount, string extra): zeroes the whole caller balance and recycles it into tokenPool, emitting Converted.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): multiply with overflow assertion (assert(c/a == b)).
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): plain division; reverts on b == 0.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): addition guarded by assert(c >= a).
msg.sender: externally controlled caller, used for balances/allowed lookups, owner checks and event fields.
block.timestamp: declared as an untrusted input category; not referenced anywhere in this contract (no timestamp dependency).
tx.origin: declared as an untrusted input category; not referenced anywhere in this contract.
_to.transfer(_value) in execute(): ETH forwarded to a caller-supplied address; the classic external-call sink (gas stipend 2300 limits reentrancy).
Bit arithmetic in checkAndConfirm: 2 ** ownerIndex and newBitFinger masking/counting of confirmations; exponent/mask logic is the security core of the multisig.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) / balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer: balance mutation arithmetic.
Sub/add arithmetic over balances[_from], balances[_to] and allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Allowance arithmetic in increaseApproval/decreaseApproval plus unconditional overwrite in approve (no zero-first race protection).
msg.value.mul(buyRate) token computation plus sub/add on tokenPool and buyer balances in buy().
balances[tokenPool].sub(_value) / balances[_admin].add(_value) in mallocBudget.
balances[msg.sender] set to 0 and balances[tokenPool].add(amount) in convertMainchainGPX: full-balance drain loop driven purely by the caller.
keccak256(msg.data) used as the pending-operation key in the mostOwner modifier; binds approvals to raw calldata.
uint256 c = a * b in SafeMath.mul: multiplication that would overflow without the following assert.
a + b in SafeMath.add and a - b in SafeMath.sub: additions/subtractions guarded by asserts.
_multiOwners: owner address array passed to the MultiOwnable constructor.
_multiRequires: required confirmation count passed to the MultiOwnable constructor.
_multiOwners: forwarded to MultiOwnable from the ParcelXGPX constructor.
_multiRequires: forwarded to MultiOwnable from the ParcelXGPX constructor.
currentUser: address whose confirmation bit is being set; supplied as msg.sender by the mostOwner modifier.
operation: bytes32 key identifying the pending multisig operation (keccak256(msg.data)).
newBuyRate: new exchange rate value written to buyRate.
_to: ETH recipient of execute(), directly used as the external call target.
_value: wei amount transferred to _to in execute().
_extra: opaque metadata string emitted in the Withdraw event.
_to: ERC20 transfer recipient in transfer().
_value: amount moved between balances in transfer().
_from: source account of the allowance-based transfer.
_to: destination account of the allowance-based transfer.
_value: amount debited from _from and from the caller's allowance.
_spender: address granted the allowance in approve().
_value: allowance amount written to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
_owner: allowance owner queried in allowance().
_spender: allowance spender queried in allowance().
_spender: allowance beneficiary in increaseApproval().
_addedValue: amount added to the caller's allowance.
_spender: allowance beneficiary in decreaseApproval().
_subtractedValue: amount removed from the caller's allowance.
_admin: beneficiary of tokens moved out of tokenPool by mallocBudget().
_value: token amount moved from tokenPool to _admin.
destinationAccount: mainchain account string; length checked between 10 and 128 bytes.
extra: opaque string forwarded in the Converted event.
_owner: account whose balance is returned by balanceOf().
size: expected payload size checked by the onlyPayloadSize modifier against msg.data.length.
a: multiplicand in SafeMath.mul.
b: multiplier in SafeMath.mul.
a: dividend in SafeMath.div.
b: divisor in SafeMath.div.
a: minuend in SafeMath.sub.
b: subtrahend in SafeMath.sub.
a: first addend in SafeMath.add.
b: second addend in SafeMath.add.
i: loop counter copying _multiOwners and checking for address(0) in the MultiOwnable constructor.
ownerIndex: index of currentUser in m_owners, or m_numOwners when the caller is not an owner.
newBitFinger: previous pending bitmask OR'd with 2 ** ownerIndex for the new confirmation.
confirmTotal: number of set bits (approvals) counted in newBitFinger.
i: loop counter used for the owner lookup and the confirmation bit count.
tokens: msg.value.mul(buyRate), the amount of GPX moved from tokenPool to the buyer.
amount: snapshot of balances[msg.sender] that is zeroed and recycled into tokenPool.
oldValue: current allowance cached before the decrease/clamp decision.
c: a * b product in SafeMath.mul, asserted against division.
c: a / b quotient in SafeMath.div.
c: a + b sum in SafeMath.add, asserted to be >= a.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes balances[msg.sender] as the debit side of transfer().
msg.sender supplies the spender key for allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the owner key overwritten in allowed[msg.sender][_spender] by approve().
msg.sender owns the allowance mutated by increaseApproval().
msg.sender owns the allowance mutated by decreaseApproval().
msg.sender is credited with tokens and is the Transfer recipient in buy().
The fallback forwards the caller context to buy(), making msg.sender the buyer.
convertMainchainGPX drains exactly balances[msg.sender] and emits msg.sender in the Converted event.
msg.sender is recorded as lastApprover in the Withdraw event emitted by execute().
The mostOwner modifier passes msg.sender into checkAndConfirm, so the caller controls the approval bit that gates pause/unpause/setBuyRate/mallocBudget/execute.
The anyOwner modifier tests isOwner(msg.sender); the caller identity decides whether the body runs.
mallocBudget is gated by mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)), which resolves through msg.sender in checkAndConfirm.
_multiOwners is copied element-wise into m_owners inside the constructor.
_multiRequires bounds-checks then initialises m_multiRequires in the constructor.
ParcelXGPX constructor forwards _multiOwners to MultiOwnable.
ParcelXGPX constructor forwards _multiRequires to MultiOwnable.
currentUser is compared against m_owners to locate ownerIndex.
operation keys m_pendings[operation] to accumulate confirmations.
newBuyRate is written directly into buyRate by setBuyRate().
_to becomes the destination of the external ETH transfer inside execute().
_value is the wei amount forwarded by _to.transfer(_value) in execute().
_extra is embedded in the Withdraw event emitted by execute().
_to is credited in balances[_to] and used in the Transfer event.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance and added to _to.
_from is the debited account in transferFrom().
_to is the credited account in transferFrom().
_value is checked against balances[_from] and allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_spender keys the allowance entry written by approve().
_value is stored verbatim into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
_owner selects the row of the allowed mapping read by allowance().
_spender selects the column of the allowed mapping read by allowance().
_spender identifies the allowance entry increased.
_addedValue is added to the current allowance.
_spender identifies the allowance entry decreased.
_subtractedValue is subtracted from or clamps to zero the allowance.
_admin is the recipient credited by mallocBudget().
_value is debited from tokenPool and credited to _admin.
destinationAccount is length-validated and emitted in Converted.
extra is emitted unchanged in the Converted event.
_owner indexes balances in balanceOf().
size feeds require(msg.data.length >= size + 4) in the onlyPayloadSize modifier on transfer.
size guards the calldata length of transferFrom.
size guards the calldata length of approve.

b is the multiplier in SafeMath.mul.
a is the dividend in SafeMath.div.
b is the divisor in SafeMath.div.

Constructor writes each owner into m_owners[i].
Constructor sets m_numOwners = _multiOwners.length.
Constructor stores m_multiRequires after the bounds check.
isOwner scans m_owners looking for currentUser.
isOwner bounds its loop with m_numOwners.
checkAndConfirm scans m_owners to find ownerIndex.
checkAndConfirm uses m_numOwners as the not-an-owner sentinel and loop bound.
checkAndConfirm compares confirmTotal against m_multiRequires.
checkAndConfirm reads, updates or deletes m_pendings[operation].
pause() flips the privileged paused flag, changing the execution mode of all whenNotPaused functions.
unpause() flips the privileged paused flag back.
isPause() returns the paused flag.
Constructor sets tokenPool = address(this) and asserts it is non-zero.
Constructor assigns the whole TOTAL_SUPPLY to balances[tokenPool].
totalSupply() returns the TOTAL_SUPPLY constant.
balanceOf() reads balances[_owner].
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[_to].
transferFrom() debits balances[_from] and credits balances[_to].
transferFrom() decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance() reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
increaseApproval() adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval() subtracts from or zeroes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
getBuyRate() reads buyRate.
setBuyRate() overwrites the pricing parameter that determines how much GPX every buy receives.
buy() debits balances[tokenPool] and credits balances[msg.sender].
buy() multiplies msg.value by the live buyRate.
mallocBudget() moves GPX out of the tokenPool balance under multisig control; an error here leaks the entire budget.
convertMainchainGPX() zeroes the caller balance and adds the amount back to balances[tokenPool].
transfer() performs sub/add over balances; correctness relies entirely on SafeMath assertions.
transferFrom() performs three chained sub/add balance and allowance mutations.
approve() writes the raw allowance value with no arithmetic guard or zero-first reset.
increaseApproval() adds to the allowance, an overflow-sensitive accumulation.
decreaseApproval() subtracts from or clamps the allowance.
buy() computes tokens = msg.value.mul(buyRate) and then sub/add on pool and buyer balances.
mallocBudget() performs sub on the pool balance and add on the admin balance.
execute() sends ETH to an arbitrary caller-supplied _to, an external call that can re-enter the contract (mitigated only by the 2300 gas transfer stipend).
convertMainchainGPX() drains the caller's full balance and adds it to the tokenPool balance.
checkAndConfirm() computes 2 ** ownerIndex and ORs it into the pending bitmask; ownerIndex comes from an unbounded owner array (max 8 enforced).
SafeMath.mul performs the raw a * b multiplication before the assert.
SafeMath.sub performs a - b guarded only by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add performs a + b guarded only by assert(c >= a).
keccak256(msg.data) is produced by the mostOwner modifier and consumed as the operation key by checkAndConfirm.
pause() is wrapped by mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)) which delegates the gate decision to checkAndConfirm.
unpause() is wrapped by mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)) which delegates the gate decision to checkAndConfirm.
setBuyRate() is wrapped by mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)) which delegates the gate decision to checkAndConfirm.
mallocBudget() is wrapped by mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)) which delegates the gate decision to checkAndConfirm.
execute() is wrapped by mostOwner(keccak256(msg.data)) which delegates the gate decision to checkAndConfirm.
The payable fallback calls buy() whenever msg.value > 0.
transfer() invokes SafeMath.sub for the sender debit.
transfer() invokes SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
transferFrom() invokes SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom() invokes SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
increaseApproval() uses SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval() uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
buy() uses SafeMath.mul to compute the token amount.
buy() uses SafeMath.sub on the tokenPool balance.
buy() uses SafeMath.add on the buyer balance.
convertMainchainGPX() uses SafeMath.add when recycling tokens to tokenPool.
Constructor loop counter i indexes _multiOwners and m_owners.
checkAndConfirm stores the located owner index in ownerIndex (m_numOwners when not an owner).
checkAndConfirm builds newBitFinger from the pending mask and the caller's bit.
checkAndConfirm accumulates the approval count in confirmTotal.
checkAndConfirm reuses loop counter i for the two owner scans.
buy() stores the computed purchase amount in tokens.
convertMainchainGPX() snapshots balances[msg.sender] into amount before zeroing it.
decreaseApproval() caches the current allowance in oldValue.
SafeMath.mul stores the product in c before asserting c / a == b.
SafeMath.div stores the quotient in c.
SafeMath.add stores the sum in c before asserting c >= a.
ownerIndex is used as the exponent in 2 ** ownerIndex; an out-of-range index would corrupt the confirmation bitmask.
newBitFinger is the bitmask that is OR'd, counted and persisted in m_pendings.
tokens feeds the pool debit and the buyer credit in buy().
amount is the full caller balance pushed back into balances[tokenPool].
oldValue is subtracted from the allowance or replaced with zero.
The product c is the value that would wrap around before the assert catches it.
The sum c is the value that would wrap around before the assert catches it.

normalization_plan.reason: _multiOwners is a pure construction-time input copied into m_owners; it has no standalone security role.
_multiRequires only initialises m_multiRequires after a bounds check in the constructor.
_multiOwners is immediately forwarded to the MultiOwnable constructor.
_multiRequires is immediately forwarded to the MultiOwnable constructor.
currentUser is only used to locate the caller inside m_owners and set the approval bit.
operation is only the m_pendings mapping key for the pending multisig action.
newBuyRate is written verbatim to the buyRate state variable.
_to is the recipient of the raw ETH transfer and therefore belongs to the external-call sink.
_value is the wei amount pushed by _to.transfer(_value).
_extra is only logged in the Withdraw event and has no security effect.
_to is the credited account in the ERC20 transfer pathway.
_value is the operand of the sub/add arithmetic that mutates balances.
_from only selects the debited balance and allowance row.
_to only selects the credited balance.
_value is the operand of the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender only keys the allowance entry written by approve().
_value is written directly as the allowance, which is the core weakness of the approve pattern.
_owner only selects the allowance row that is read.
_spender only selects the allowance column that is read.
_spender only identifies the allowance entry being increased.
_addedValue is the operand of the allowance addition.
_spender only identifies the allowance entry being decreased.
_subtractedValue drives the allowance subtraction/clamp branch.
_admin is only the beneficiary credited with tokens moved out of tokenPool.
_value is the operand of the tokenPool debit and admin credit arithmetic.
destinationAccount is only validated for length and emitted in the Converted event.
extra is only opaque metadata attached to the Converted event.
_owner only selects the balance mapping entry that is returned.
size only configures the calldata length requirement of the onlyPayloadSize modifier used by the ERC20 entry points.
a is a direct operand of the raw a * b multiplication.
b is a direct operand of the raw a * b multiplication.
a is only the dividend of the unchecked division.
b is only the divisor of the division.
a is the minuend of the a - b subtraction.
b is the subtrahend that the assert(b <= a) guard constrains.

b is an operand of the a + b addition constrained by assert(c >= a).
